description: SIHTIO crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C50 H44 N4 O9 Tb2. From the CIF bond table, Tb1 (Tb) has 6 O neighbors; Tb2 (Tb) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.875-3.875 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.23-111.22°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C50H44N4O9Tb2. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
